title: Magnetic Force on Moving Charges
notes: **Magnetic Force on Moving Charges:** This topic covers the fundamental concepts of magnetic force on moving charges in the physics curriculum.
Understanding magnetic force on moving charges is essential for solving problems and building higher-level mathematical skills.
Key definitions and theorems related to magnetic force on moving charges should be memorized and practiced regularly.
confusion: ❌ 'A magnetic force can do work on a charged particle.' ✅ Magnetic force is always *perpendicular* to velocity, so it does *zero work*; it changes direction, not speed.
❌ 'A stationary charge experiences magnetic force.' ✅ The particle *must be moving* (v ≠ 0) and not parallel to B; a stationary charge feels no magnetic force.
❌ 'The force direction is given by the right-hand rule for negative charges too.' ✅ For *negative* charges (electrons), reverse the right-hand rule direction (or use left hand).
